claim.model_class: pt-v1 (the shipped preset) with the searched parameters free
claim.search_space_source: CALIBRATION-RESULTS.md §5, the measured identifiability spectrum (not §3.9's argued list)

method.box_rule: §6.3's ~[1/4x, 4x] of the shipped value, intersected with each parameter's hard range
method.loss: tradefloor.loss.band_distance_loss (the shipped objective) + lambda * sum_j dev_j^2 (§6.3)

optimiser.implementation: falsify.py's (mu/mu_w, lambda) CMA-ES and compass polish, unmodified
stages: compass polish on the search subset
compass polish on the full training set
shrink: compass polish at the shrink lambda

seed_sd_provenance.cross_check: agrees to six significant figures with the seed_sd of tools/calibration/results/jacobian-pt-v1-2026-08-22-chunk1.json, measured independently by the phase-2 instrument on the same thirty seeds
seed_sd_provenance.pinned_by: tests/test_loss.py re-measures two of the thirty seeds live and re-derives the sd from the committed per-seed table
seed_sd_provenance.source: re-measured on the shipped preset: facts.measure() on Universe.random(40, seed=111), 252 days, seeds 101-130, sample sd across seeds

overfitting.rule: §8: any trained-to statistic in band on train and out of band on a validation axis; or validation L_real exceeding train L_real by more than 2x the bootstrap spread of train L_real across its seeds
